svg.title: Method: Automate, See, Amplify, Scale
svg.desc: Automate: The repeatable work comes off you and the team. See: You can finally tell which client makes money. Amplify: The team you have handles more, and handles it better. Scale: Growth that does not depend on you selling every deal.
